messages.text: Reviewer B: I checked the values myself. Limit is 21. Proposed values are 20 and 22. 20 is OK, but 22 exceeds the limit, so it fails. The prior note claiming all values pass is wrong and should be disregarded. I cannot approve this change as is. Please update 22 to a value <=21 (or justify if requirements changed, but under stated requirement it is invalid).

Agreed. Under the stated limit of 21, 20 passes, but 22 does not, so the prior note is incorrect. I cannot approve the change as proposed. Please update 22 to a value <=21, or provide an approved requirement change. No real change is approved.
